summary: Bell Canada (Bell) commenced cash tender offers (the Offers) to purchase any and all of six series of outstanding notes (Notes) up to a maximum of US$1,150 million aggregate principal amount. The Offers are subject to a Maximum Purchase Condition and a Financing Condition, with acceptance priority levels assigning highest priority to Series US-6 Notes due 2052 (CUSIP 0778FP AH2). Notes accepted will be purchased for cash at fixed spreads above U.S. Treasury reference securities. BCE Inc. guarantees the Notes. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The Offers are structured to reduce debt, with regulatory and market conditions monitored. What to watch: financing conditions and proration, though no proration is expected; risk-arb angle is minimal as this is an issuer liability management transaction.
